## Larynx 31 · Read-only API

Only two authenticated GET routes are exposed. PostgreSQL nodes issue SELECT statements against the real `larynx31` tables. Phone numbers are masked inside SQL before they leave the ledger.

After import, select the dedicated `Larynx31 Read API Header Auth` and least-privilege `Larynx31 Ledger Readonly` credentials. Never reuse the provider or intake credential.
